response.sql:
WITH per_media_type AS (
  SELECT MediaTypeId,
         AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond,
         COUNT(*) AS track_count
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes >= 10323804
    AND Bytes IS NOT NULL
    AND Milliseconds IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
)
SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_millisecond) AS avg_of_media_type_averages,
       AVG(track_count) AS avg_of_media_type_track_counts
FROM per_media_type;

assumptions.assumption: “Large track files” means tracks with Bytes at least 10,323,804; the stated size is treated as an inclusive cutoff.
Missing Bytes or Milliseconds values are excluded from the per-media-type average; tracks with missing values are also excluded from the large-file count because their size cannot be established.

alternatives.interpretation: If 10,323,804 is an exclusive cutoff, include only tracks larger than that value.
